note: C-9 R-C9-61 T1: the knight test skin's frame set. The BUILDER reads this; to swap the placeholder for the real 8-direction set, change source_root and set placeholder=false. That is the one-line change the dispatch asks for.
placeholder_note: PLACEHOLDER: runs/C-9/meshy_test/paint_a is the Meshy+Astra E walk ONLY -- one direction, one action. It is used for all 8 directions and stretched across the other states so the pipeline can be wired and walked now. Every direction shows the same E-facing cycle, so the knight does NOT turn. That is expected and is labelled on the HUD; it is not a rig fault.
layout: {state}/{dir}/f_NN.png  (the real set may instead use {state}/{dir}/{state}_{dir}_NN.png; the builder accepts either)   Paths are relative to the RUN dir, runs/C-9.

idle.why: the placeholder has no idle cycle; frame 0 held. The Keeper's idle is 16 frames over 2.0 s.

walk.why: 12 frames at 20.7 fps = 0.5797 s, the Keeper's own walk stride, read from frames/keeper.tres

run.why: The painted RUN cells are on hold at the run's Astra image cap, so the run plays the WALK cells at the Keeper's RUN stride. `cadence` derives the fps from however many walk cells actually shipped, so this stays correct whatever the frame count is. When painted run cells land, set from='run' and drop hud_note.

attack.why: Not delivered -- the attack paint is behind the same image cap. The skin falls back to idle and says so once on the console rather than silently showing a walk. The 3D skin keeps its own real attack clip; only the SPRITE skin is short of paint.

source_faces_note: The stand-in column faces LEFT on screen -- it is W-facing art. Measured against the Keeper's own cells, where E faces right and W faces left. The builder mirrors it for E-ward directions. A real per-direction set has its own art for every direction: set this to the empty string and nothing is mirrored.

swap_when_sprites_t1_lands.note: The first delivery is IDLE + WALK in all 8 directions only. run stays from='walk' with its hud_note; attack stays from=null. source_faces goes EMPTY -- a real per-direction set has its own art for every direction and must mirror nothing.
